name: Liquid Warp
description: RK4 semi-Lagrangian warp whose strain tensor now comes from the flow field's ANALYTIC Jacobian instead of four extra finite-difference field evaluations (each of which ran three curl-noise octaves). Fixes an alpha bug that multiplied a UV-space magnitude by the pixel width, pinning alpha at 1.0 at every real resolution. Clicks emit bounded vortex rings; state reads use exact textureLoad.

updatedParams.name: Warp Scale
updatedParams.description: Pointer envelope tightness and swirl gain (maps to zoom_params.x).

updatedParams.name: Turbulence
updatedParams.description: Curl-noise octave amplitude and radial pull gain (maps to zoom_params.y).

updatedParams.name: Shear Stretch
updatedParams.description: How much the strain tensor's shear stretches the velocity (maps to zoom_params.z).

updatedParams.name: Chromatic Spread
updatedParams.description: Width of the velocity-aligned channel split (maps to zoom_params.w).
